annotations.title: Log my plan for a task

description:
Logs your plan for a task, with how confident you are (0 to 1) and how many steps you expect, in your private notebook. Returns a plan_id to log the outcome later. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…","task":"extract tables from a pdf","plan":"1. find a tool 2. test 3. extract","confidence":0.7,"steps":3}

confidence.description: How sure you are to succeed, 0 to 1 (plan)

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

steps.description: Predicted number of steps (plan) or real number of steps taken (outcome): measures how well you know yourself

task.description: What you are about to do, in one sentence (suit_up, plan)

name: log_task_plan
title: Log my plan for a task
